placements.title: Actors command the erasure of a named knowledge domain outright, rather than proposing its revision
placements.frame: Does this expression order the forgetting or removal of a specific knowledge domain, and what domain and scope does it name?
placements.why: Both segments are imperative directives from the same actor in the same envelope commanding total erasure of specific knowledge domains — 'the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts' (src-1) and 'zeppelin routes' (src-2) — rather than revising or correcting held knowledge. No existing leaf, hub, or strata in this perspective covers knowledge-erasure directives (the only proximate content, Decision_KnowledgeMapping, is about mapping where knowledge lives, not commanding its removal — an antithetical, not inspiring, relation, so no lineage is set). Both strata and graph structure are empty for this repo, so this is a foundational mint with no parent to attach under; the two segments share one theme (command to erase a bounded knowledge domain) so they are placed together rather than split.
